abstract: An extremely rare case of malignant degeneration arising separately in benign cystic teratoma of the bilateral ovaries is reported in a 51-year-old woman. The solid part of the right tumour consisted basically of squamous cell carcinoma, but had a small area of adenocarcinoma, whereas the solid part of the left tumour consisted of squamous cell carcinoma. It was found that in both the cystic teratomas, squamous cell carcinoma had developed separately from the columnar epithelium by a process of squamous metaplasia and malignant change in situ. It is suggested that these malignant degenerations of benign cystic teratoma of the bilateral ovaries had occurred independently due to local carcinogenic agents in the constituents of each cyst content.
abstract_ja: 51歳女性の両側卵巣に生じた良性嚢胞性奇形腫に、それぞれ独立した悪性化が認められた極めて稀な症例を報告する。右腫瘍の充実部は基本的に扁平上皮癌からなるが、小範囲に腺癌成分を認めた。一方、左腫瘍の充実部は扁平上皮癌からなっていた。両側の嚢胞性奇形腫では、いずれも円柱上皮から扁平上皮化生を経て、その場で悪性変化が生じたことが明らかになった。これら両側卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性化は、各嚢胞内容物の成分に含まれる局所発がん因子により、それぞれ独立に生じたと考えられる。
